title: The Fire at Taberah
description: The people complained, and the Lord heard it. His anger burned, and fire from the Lord broke out among them and consumed the outskirts of the camp. The people cried out to Moses, who prayed to the Lord, and the fire died down. So that place was called Taberah, because there the Lord's fire had burned. [ref:Num 11:1-3|Numbers 11:1-3]
